# Overview

CatColab is under active development with new features added regularly. We aim

## What is CatColab?

*... CatColab is a **collaborative** environment for **formal**, **interoperable**, **conceptual** modeling*
- Further reading: [Fundamentals of CatColab](/help/guides/fundamentals)

*... CatColab is an open-source software project*
- Source code: [GitHub ↗](https://github.com/ToposInstitute/CatColab)
- Community chat: [Zulip ↗](https://catcolab.zulipchat.com)

*... CatColab is a technology created by Topos Institute and our partners*
- [CatColab credits](/help/credits)
- [Topos Institute website ↗](https://topos.institute)

You can reach us via email [here](mailto:catcolab@topos.institute) with any questions, comments, or suggestions.


## Using CatColab

The general process of using CatColab looks something like the following:

1. Select a **logic**
2. Build a **model** within the above logic
3. Run various **analyses** on your model.

For more information, see the [guides](/help/guides) or dive into the help pages for [logics](/help/logics).
